title: File:Map showing extent of 2013 Southeast Asian haze - 20130619.png
desc: Extent of the 2013 Southeast Asian haze as of 19 June. Wind direction is shown by the grey arrows. Red dots indicate a haze source (hotspot). The red encirclement indicates areas where the haze is the thickest, while the orange encirclement indicates areas where the haze is significantly thick.

title: File:Effects of 2013 Southeast Asian haze on Singapore.jpg
desc: This picture, taken near Rifle Range Road, shows the effect of the 2013 Southeast Asian haze on Singapore. Normally, the hills in the background can be clearly seen.
